The Washington Post on Instagram: "Autumn Durald Arkapaw made Oscar history Sunday night as the first woman and first woman of color to win for Best Cinematography for her work on "Sinners."

While accepting the Academy Award, Arkapaw asked the women in the theater to please stand. “I’m so honored to be here, and I really want all the women in the room to stand up because I feel like I don’t get here without you," she said. 

Catch more of the winners by tapping the link in @washingtonpost's bio."
